title: Contractor Dispatch Standard for Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
**1. When a contractor is dispatched.** A contractor is dispatched on a Real Estate Service Contracts service request only while the contract status is listing coverage or active, as read from the contract's system record. Requests recorded while the contract is closed pending payment wait and are dispatched once the plan invoice is paid and coverage is confirmed.

**2. Which contractor.** The request goes to a network contractor whose trade matches and whose service ZIP codes include the property ZIP code, preferred before standard, never suspended, and emergency-capable for an emergency; ties go to the contractor reference that sorts first alphabetically.

**3. Contact window.** The contractor contacts the caller within the plan's routine contact window in hours, or the plan's emergency contact window in hours for an emergency, measured from the assignment. A missed contact window leads to re-dispatch, recorded as a re-dispatch after a missed contact window.

**4. Recalls.** A recall goes to the contractor that did the original work unless that contractor is now suspended.

**5. Sequence.** Each assignment carries the next dispatch sequence number, starting at 1.

## Selection order, restated

| Test | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Trade | matches the request's trade |
| Service area | the contractor's service ZIP codes include the property ZIP code |
| Standing | never suspended |
| Emergency | emergency-capable, for an emergency request |
| Preference | preferred contractors before standard contractors |
| Tie | the contractor reference that sorts first alphabetically |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical network)

For a hypothetical emergency plumbing request at a property ZIP code served by three plumbing contractors — one preferred but not emergency-capable, two standard and emergency-capable with references "C-210" and "C-118" — the preferred contractor is excluded for the emergency, and the tie between the two standard contractors goes to "C-118", the reference that sorts first alphabetically. If that contractor misses the plan's emergency contact window, the request is re-dispatched with the next dispatch sequence number, 2.
